title: Extrusion Lamination Team Leader
description:
**Enjoy a career, packaged with care, whilst helping protect food, people and the planet**
 We are a key global provider of sustainable packaging solutions. We’re on a mission to make all packaging recyclable, reusable, or compostable. Every day, we ensure the hygiene and safety of food and drink for people around the world. We are Huhtamaki.
   

  

 You could be part of our vision. Because it’s our talented people that make it happen. Our people on the shop floor producing innovative, sustainable products. Our people in our offices delivering excellence for our customers every day. It’s every one of us working together.
   

  

 We offer a place where you can feel safe, be supported, and make an impact so we can all focus on the future together.
   

  

* Work as first line machine operator and monitor the Tandem Extrusion Lamination machine, including extruders, unwinder, laminating/nip stations, chillers, winding and associated systems.
* Set and control critical process parameters such as extruder temperature, melt temperature, pressure, screw RPM, line speed, coating weight, nip pressure, corona treatment and web tension.
* Ensure correct resin, additives, substrate and adhesive/material specifications as per job card and approved recipe.
* Carry out machine start\-up, changeover, shutdown and grade/product changeover as per SOP.
* Monitor laminate quality for bond strength, coating weight, appearance, wrinkles, air entrapment, tunnelling, delamination, gauge variation, edge build\-up and winding quality.
* Maintain required OEE, productivity, wastage and line\-speed targets while ensuring product quality.
* Identify process abnormalities and take immediate corrective action to minimize breakdowns, defects, rework and wastage.
* Conduct first\-level troubleshooting of machine/process\-related issues and coordinate with Maintenance, Quality, Production Planning and Process/Technical teams when required.
* Ensure accurate recording of production quantity, wastage, downtime, process parameters and material consumption in ERP/system and relevant production records.
* Follow approved SOPs, work instructions, quality standards, safety procedures and 5S requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and reconciliation of resins, substrates, cores and other production materials.
* Participate in RCA, 5\-Why, CAPA, Kaizen and continuous improvement activities to reduce wastage and improve machine efficiency.
* Maintain housekeeping around the machine and ensure safe working conditions at all times.
* Communicate shift\-wise production status, machine abnormalities, quality issues and pending actions during shift handover.
* QualificationITI, Diploma, or Graduate
* .ExperienceMinimum 8 years of experience operating Extrusion lamination machines mainly tandem machine


 Join us. Help protect food, people and the planet.

title: Senior Manager/Manager
description:
**Designation:** 
 Manager / Senior Manager \- Production Planning \& Inventory Control (PPIC)
 



**Location:** 
 Khopoli, Maharashtra
 



**Department:** 
 Supply Chain \& Manufacturing Operations
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head Supply Chain / Plant Head
 



**Qualification** 
 : B. Tech / B.E. in Chemical Engineering. MBA in Operations, Supply Chain
 



**Experience** 
 : 12 yrs to 18 Yrs (API / Pharmaceutical Manufacturing OR Specialty Chemicals OR Contract Manufacturing
 



**Role Purpose** 




 The Manager / Senior Manager \- Production Planning \& Inventory Control (PPIC) will lead end\-to\-end production planning, material management, inventory control, capacity planning, and cross\-functional coordination to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing operations and timely customer deliveries. The role will support pilot and commercial manufacturing in a CDMO setup through robust planning systems, inventory optimization, and effective utilization of resources.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Production Planning \& Scheduling** 



* Develop monthly, weekly, and daily production plans based on customer demand, sales forecasts, and plant capacities.
* Monitor production schedules and ensure adherence to committed delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Warehouse, Quality Assurance, Engineering, and Commercial teams for smooth execution.
* Drive capacity planning and resource optimization across manufacturing facilities.
* Manage production exceptions, bottlenecks, and recovery plans to minimize business impact.



**Inventory Control \& Material Management** 



* Monitor and optimize inventory levels of raw materials, intermediates, solvents, packaging materials, WIP, and finished goods.
* Establish inventory norms, safety stock levels, reorder points, and inventory control mechanisms.
* Identify and reduce excess, slow\-moving, and non\-moving inventories.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of critical materials and manage shortages proactively.
* Conduct inventory reviews, reconciliations, and stock accuracy improvement initiatives.



**Material Requirement Planning (MRP)** 



* Lead MRP activities and convert production plans into procurement requirements.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Procurement teams for timely sourcing of materials.
* Track supplier performance and material availability.
* Raise purchase requisitions and monitor procurement timelines.
* Mitigate risks associated with critical and imported raw materials.



**Supply Chain \& Customer Coordination** 



* Coordinate order fulfillment activities and ensure delivery commitments are met.
* Liaise with Project Management and Commercial teams to align production plans with customer requirements.
* Monitor order book status and ensure timely order closure.
* Handle production shortages and communicate mitigation plans to stakeholders.



**Continuous Improvement \& Operational Excellence** 



* Drive inventory reduction and working capital optimization initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, productivity enhancement, and cost optimization.
* Lead cross\-functional projects focused on operational excellence.
* Improve planning accuracy, schedule adherence, and inventory turnover.
* Support sustainability initiatives through waste minimization and solvent recovery programs.



**Compliance \& Audit Support** 



* Ensure compliance with GMP, EHS, and quality requirements.
* Support customer, regulatory, and internal audits.
* Maintain accurate planning and inventory documentation.
* Participate in deviation investigations, CAPA implementation, and change control activities.



**SAP \& Production Systems** 



* Manage PPIC activities through SAP.
* Create and maintain:
* Material Masters
* BOMs
* Master Recipes
* Production/Process Orders
* Goods Receipt \& Goods Issue Transactions
* Generate MIS reports, inventory reports, and planning dashboards using SAP and Excel.

title: Site Operations & Inventory Control Manager
description:
**Job Description \- Site Operations \& Inventory Control Manager** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 The
 **Site Operations \& Inventory Control Manager** 
 will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end ecommerce fulfillment site operations, including inbound, putaway, inventory control, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, stock reconciliation, vendor discrepancy reporting, manpower productivity, SLA adherence, and SOP compliance. The role will act as the
 **single point of ownership for site performance, inventory accuracy, inbound quality, process discipline, and operational issue resolution** 
 . The person will ensure that the warehouse operates efficiently, stock records remain accurate, and all incoming and outgoing inventory movements are controlled as per brand standards.
 



  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* A strong interest in Site Operations and Inventory Control Management.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills for ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Ownership\-driven attitude—comfortable taking charge of projects end\-to\-end
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines



  





**You should not apply if you:** 



* Struggle with ownership and require constant supervision to drive tasks
* Are uncomfortable working with data, numbers, or analytical problem\-solving
* Are not willing to collaborate with cross\-functional teams or external partners
* Avoid negotiation, communication, or vendor/brand interaction



  





**Skills Required** 



* Strong understanding of ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations.
* Good command over inbound, GRN, inventory control, dispatch, returns, and audit processes.
* Knowledge of SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, barcode, PO, invoice, ASN, GRN, and stock adjustment processes.
* Strong attention to detail and counting accuracy.
* Ability to identify stock discrepancies, quality issues, and process gaps.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets / MIS reporting skills.
* Understanding of WMS, OMS, ERP, and courier systems; Vinculum knowledge preferred.
* Ability to manage third\-party manpower and ensure SOP compliance.



  





**What you will do:** 




  





**1\. End\-to\-End Site Operations Management** 



* Own daily warehouse / darkstore operations, including inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and inventory control.
* Ensure orders are processed within defined cut\-off times and SLA timelines.
* Monitor daily order volume, pending orders, aging orders, SLA breaches, and operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with central operations, logistics, product, inventory planning, procurement, finance, and customer support teams.
* Ensure smooth order fulfilment across B2C, marketplace, darkstore, and other ecommerce channels, wherever applicable.



**2\. SLA \& Performance Management** 



* Track and improve key operational metrics, including order processing TAT, dispatch TAT, pick\-pack accuracy, inventory accuracy, manpower productivity, and order breach percentage.
* Review site performance daily through dashboards, MIS, exception reports, and pending trackers.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive corrective actions.
* Prepare daily / weekly performance updates for leadership review.
* Highlight operational risks proactively with root cause and action plan.



**3\. Inventory Accuracy \& Stock Governance** 



* Ensure accurate stock storage, bin mapping, SKU hygiene, batch tracking, expiry tracking, FEFO / FIFO adherence, and stock reconciliation.
* Conduct and supervise daily, weekly, and monthly cycle counts as per audit plan.
* Verify physical stock against system stock at SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, and bin level.
* Identify stock mismatches, short/excess quantities, wrong bin placements, missing labels, unscannable barcodes, and location errors.
* Monitor shrinkage, damaged stock, expired stock, dead stock, slow\-moving stock, and high\-value inventory.
* Ensure expired, damaged, leaked, or unsellable stock is quarantined and marked correctly.
* Maintain strict controls for high\-value, fast\-moving, fragile, and expiry\-sensitive SKUs.



**4\. Inbound Audit \& GRN Control** 



* Audit incoming stock against PO, invoice, ASN, delivery challan, and system records.
* Verify SKU name, SKU code, quantity, batch number, expiry date, MRP, barcode, and packaging condition.
* Ensure received stock matches system expectations before GRN closure.
* Identify shortages, excess quantity, wrong SKUs, duplicate items, damaged products, near\-expiry stock, expired stock, leakage, tampering, or invoice mismatch.
* Validate GRN entries for accuracy and ensure all discrepancies are recorded before stock acceptance.
* Prevent unauthorized inwarding of stock without a PO or required approval.
* Ensure only audited and approved stock moves to putaway.



**5\. Vendor, Transporter \& Discrepancy Management** 



* Report vendor\-side and transporter\-side issues such as wrong dispatch, short supply, excess supply, damaged goods, expiry mismatch, MRP mismatch, or invoice mismatch.
* Capture proper evidence through photos, quantity records, signed discrepancy notes, and audit reports.
* Maintain inbound discrepancy logs, rejection reports, vendor issue reports, damage reports, and GRN correction records.
* Coordinate with procurement, planning, finance, and warehouse teams for discrepancy closure.
* Track vendor discrepancy closure and ensure repeated issues are escalated with data.



**6\. Putaway, Storage \& Bin Discipline** 



* Ensure stock is moved from the receiving area to the correct storage/bin location within the defined TAT.
* Validate correct labeling, barcode scanning, batch tagging, expiry marking, and SKU placement before storage.
* Prevent wrong putaway of unaudited or rejected stock.
* Ensure bin accuracy across racks, storage zones, pick faces, and bulk locations.
* Identify mixed SKUs, wrong bin mapping, wrong batch placement, and missing labels.
* Coordinate correction of bin\-level discrepancies with the warehouse team.



**7\. Team \& Manpower Management** 



* Monitor whether warehouse staff, supervisors, pickers, packers, auditors, and third\-party manpower are following brand\-defined SOPs.
* Plan manpower as per order load, sale days, campaigns, and business peaks.
* Conduct daily briefings to align teams on order priorities, pending workload, SLA risks, and process discipline.
* Track manpower productivity and identify areas of underutilization or bottlenecks.
* Ensure clear shift\-wise ownership for inbound, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and audits.



**8\. Process Compliance \& Site Audit** 



* Ensure SOP adherence across inbound, storage, putaway, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, and stock adjustment processes.
* Perform site audits in accordance with brand guidelines.
* Maintain documentation for audits, stock movements, damages, GRN, dispatches, returns, rejected stock, and stock adjustments.
* Ensure all stock adjustments are properly documented and approved as per the process.
* Support internal and external audits with required data and records.
* Ensure safety, hygiene, security, and compliance standards are followed at the site.



**9\. Returns \& Reverse Inventory Control** 



* Ensure returned stock is received, audited, QC\-checked, and moved to the correct inventory status.
* Validate return discrepancies such as wrong item received, missing item, damaged item, used product, or non\-sellable return.
* Track return\-to\-sellable %, return QC TAT, and rejected return stock.
* Coordinate with customer support, logistics, and finance teams for return closure and refund\-related dependencies.



**10\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation** 



* Act as the first escalation point for site\-level operational and inventory\-related issues.
* Resolve issues related to stock mismatch, GRN errors, order delays, manpower shortage, courier handover delays, return discrepancies, system discrepancies, and damaged stock.
* Prepare RCA for repeated inventory mismatches, inbound discrepancies, dispatch delays, and SOP deviations.
* Escalate critical risks proactively with data, business impact, and a corrective action plan.



  





**Work Experience** 




  





**3–5 years** 
 in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, inventory control, inbound operations, stock audit, darkstore operations, retail fulfillment, supply chain operations, FMCG, supplement, pharma\-like product handling, or logistics operations.
 



 Experience in a
 **D2C, e\-commerce, supplement, FMCG, pharma, beauty, or personal care warehouse** 
 will be preferred because these categories require tighter control over expiry, batch, MRP, damage, leakage, and return quality.
 



  





**Working days: 6 Days Working** 




  





**Location:** 
 Bhiwandi, Maharashtra (On\-site)
 



  





**Perks:** 



* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible Timings
* Diverse work environment



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life’s best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that’s revolutionising the health industry.
 



  





 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers to now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute towards further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





**Funding:** 




 We raised $5 million in a Series A funding.
 



  





*Nutrabay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, colour, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, political affiliation, race, ethnicity, religion or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.*

title: Lead Construction Manager
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
 The Lead Construction Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all construction activities related to civil, structural, and mechanical disciplines during project execution. The role ensures safe, high\-quality, and efficient delivery of construction works while achieving project objectives related to scope, schedule, cost, quality, and compliance. The position serves as the primary site leader coordinating contractors, engineers, suppliers, and stakeholders throughout construction, commissioning support, and project handover.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Construction Leadership \& Site Management**
* Lead all site construction activities across civil, structural, mechanical, piping, and utility scopes.
* Establish execution strategies, construction methodologies, and resource plans.
* Direct field teams and contractors to ensure efficient execution of work packages.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for site construction performance.


**Civil \& Structural Construction Management**
* Oversee earthworks, excavation, foundations, piling, concrete structures, buildings, roads, drainage systems, and underground utilities.
* Ensure construction activities are executed according to approved designs, specifications, and engineering standards.
* Coordinate interfaces between civil works and mechanical installation activities.


**Mechanical Construction Management**
* Lead installation of process equipment, utilities, piping systems, HVAC, tanks, pumps, and supporting infrastructure.
* Ensure proper sequencing of equipment erection, alignment, testing, and mechanical completion.
* Support commissioning and start\-up readiness activities.
* Resolve field technical issues in collaboration with engineering teams and vendors.


**Contractor \& Stakeholder Management**
* Manage EPC/EPCM contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and suppliers.
* Conduct contractor performance reviews and monitor productivity.
* Lead construction progress meetings and coordinate stakeholder alignment.
* Ensure effective communication between project management, engineering, operations, maintenance, and safety teams.


**Safety, Health \& Environmental Management**
* Promote and enforce a zero\-accident safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, and regulatory standards.
* Lead risk assessments, toolbox talks, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Drive EHS compliance throughout project execution.


**Schedule, Cost \& Risk Management**
* Monitor construction schedules, milestones, and productivity metrics.
* Identify critical path risks and develop recovery plans when required.
* Control construction budgets and manage variations, claims, and change orders.
* Support forecasting and reporting to project leadership.


**Quality Assurance \& Compliance**
* Ensure implementation of QA/QC processes, inspection plans, and testing requirements.
* Review and approve method statements, inspection records, and construction documentation.
* Drive first\-time\-right execution and minimize rework.
* Ensure statutory, regulatory, and company compliance requirements are met.


**Commissioning \& Handover**
* Coordinate mechanical completion and turnover processes.
* Ensure punch\-list closure and construction readiness for commissioning.
* Support operational acceptance, training, and project handover.
* Ensure as\-built documentation and final project records are complete.


**In this role you’ll make an impact by:**
* Delivering complex construction projects safely, on time, and within budget while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.
* Leading multidisciplinary civil and mechanical construction teams to achieve key project milestones and operational readiness.
* Driving construction excellence through proactive planning, contractor management, and risk mitigation.
* Ensuring seamless integration between civil infrastructure, mechanical systems, utilities, equipment installation, and commissioning activities.
* Creating a strong safety culture that prioritizes people, environmental sustainability, and operational integrity.
* Enabling successful project handover through disciplined execution, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration.


**To succeed:**
**Qualifications**

description:
